title: PanKbase Office Hours Recording for October 22, 2026 Now Live
bodyHtml:
Unable to join today's PanKbase Office Hours? The recording is now LIVE!

? PanKgraph: Trustworthy Natural Language Search for T1D and Pancreas Research
?️ Featured speaker: Yiqun Wang

Topics covered:
Ask biological questions in plain language: Search connected T1D and pancreas resources without writing database queries.
Trace answers to supporting evidence: See how structured knowledge, source provenance, and controlled AI workflows support reliable interpretation.
Explore research examples: Connect T1D genetic associations to candidate genes and identify HPAP donors and samples for specific study criteria.

? Watch the recording: https://youtu.be/4nKGGWM1GkE

Please feel free to forward to interested colleagues!
summary: Yiqun Wang presented “PanKgraph: Trustworthy Natural Language Search for T1D and Pancreas Research.”
